name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd
title: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd - 500008 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Lead-acid core growing ~12% with 4W OEM volumes up 30%+, but raw-material inflation (lead ~₹2 lakh/t) squeezes margins; FY27 capex ₹1,500–1,700 crore, mostly New Energy, with ₹2,000 crore-plus cell plans still unproven on returns.

utilisation.quote: that plant is operating at about 30 million Ah, 40 million Ah kind of a capacity

capex.quote: we would be spending an amount in the range of INR1,500 crores to INR1,700 crores as capex

triggers.label: FY27 capex ₹1,500–1,700 cr
triggers.quote: we would be spending an amount in the range of INR1,500 crores to INR1,700 crores as capex

triggers.label: Further 2–3% price hike flagged
triggers.quote: in my view, at least another 2% to 3% kind of a price increase is something that we should look for

triggers.label: 4W & 2W OEM volumes up 30%+
triggers.quote: both the OEMs, both in the 4-wheeler and 2-wheeler have grown more than 30% during the current quarter

triggers.label: Lead-acid margin ~12% despite inflation
triggers.quote: we are able to sustain operating margins about 12% despite tremendous cost pressures

triggers.label: Giga 1 pushed to June 2027
triggers.quote: The first 2 gigawatt hour line, Giga 1 is still on progress -- is in line to start production in June of 2027.

guidance.quote: we would -- we are still hopeful to reach a 13% to 14% kind of an EBITDA margin even at a 2 lakh kind of a lead base
we'll continue to see that mid to high single-digit growth

guidance.value: INR1,500-1,700 crore (~400 lead acid, 1,100-1,200 New Energy)
guidance.quote: we would be spending an amount in the range of INR1,500 crores to INR1,700 crores as capex
The operating margins could be around, let's say, 6% to 7% to start with.
if we can achieve a scale of about 8 to 10 gigawatt hour, we see that there is a possibility of an EBITDA margin in the range of 10% to 11%

red_flags.label: Giga factory delayed to June 2027
red_flags.quote: The first 2 gigawatt hour line, Giga 1 is still on progress -- is in line to start production in June of 2027.

red_flags.label: Gotion tech licensing stalled
red_flags.quote: sharing of technology, licensing technology is something that's been largely discouraged by the Chinese government

red_flags.label: Export volumes muted
red_flags.quote: we have seen a muted growth in the export volumes of Automotive business

evasions.quote: It would be difficult for me to put a number immediately.
There are still some moving parts
